card.name: Digits inside 75 and 7.5 dose numbers
card.fires_on: A digit or decimal point partway through a number that is built from 7 and 5, such as 37.5, 112.5, 225, 525 or 750. It appears in dose tables and dosing text, usually just before mg.

modes.label: Decimal point in x.5 values
modes.description: The decimal point inside numbers like 7.5 or 37.5 after a leading 7 or 3.
modes.example: Pediatric patients 6 to 11 years 37<<.>>5 mg orally once daily for 6

modes.label: Middle digit of 25/50 numbers
modes.description: The digit before a final 5 or 50 in numbers like 225, 525, 750 or 12.5.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated to dose numbers (the word view), so there is no clear link to the output.
card.plain: It fires inside dose numbers that look like 75, 7.5, 37.5 or 225 mg, just before the number ends.
